issue_context.title: Add metrics and telemetry for aggressive locking
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Ref: https://github.com/tikv/tikv/issues/13298

This feature introduced a new locking mechanism named aggressive locking to TiDB. To know whether it works, we need to add metrics and telemetry to it.

review_comments: We may add some comments to explain about the meaning of `Used` and `Effective`.
Also in TxnCtx. These 2 names can be confusing
